programme.desc: Tom Carter envoie son fils Billy chercher l'aide du shérif lorsque la ferme est attaquée par les hommes de main du voisin Jon Pryce.

programme.desc: Pendant la guerre de Sécession, Border City est une ville située à la frontière entre le Missouri et l'Arkansas, au pied des montagnes Ozark.

programme.title: Les Vengeurs de l'Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann est un tireur informé par un ami d'enfance que son père a été assassiné des années plus tôt par sa mère et son amant.

programme.title: Un par un... sans pitié
programme.desc: Bill apprend que son père, pendant la guerre civile américaine, a été accusé de vol et tué. Faisant équipe avec un ancien éclaireur mexicain qui était présent et qui a été laissé pour mort, ils entreprennent de se venger et de retrouver l'argent volé.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé

programme.title: Les Femmes de Jesse James
programme.desc: Jesse James est tellement occupé à courir les jupons que sa carrière de hors-la-loi commence à en pâtir.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: It Came from the Desert
programme.desc: Les fourmis sont les véritables vedettes de ce buddy-movie qui rend un hommage direct aux films de monstres des années 50. Inspiré du cultissime jeu vidéo des années 80 It came from the desert ce film déjanté est un fabuleux mélange de fourmis géantes et de courses de moto dans le désert… Nouveau Mexique - Se rendant à une Keg Party où la bière coule à flots nos 2 coureurs de motocross vont faire une rencontre inattendue en tombant par hasard sur un ancien site militaire. Des expérimentations secrètes visant à croiser leur l'ADN avec des débris d'une métérorite trouvée en 1951 ont été menées sur des fourmis et araignées….et qui ont donné naissance à des fourmis géantes mutantes !

programme.title: Never cry werewolf
programme.desc: Jared Martin emménage chez les Hansett, avec sa moto sexy et son chien étrange et mal luné. Bien que tous les habitants du quartier l'apprécient immédiatement, Loren Hansett n'arrive pas à se débarrasser des mauvaises ondes que lui transmet son nouveau voisin. Elle commence à espionner ses activités nocturnes et en vient à penser qu'un meurtre récent pourrait être l'œuvre d'un loup-garou qui se trouve être son nouveau voisin. Ses recherches sur Internet lui fournissent de nombreux détails sur la collaboration, mais tout le monde, à l'exception de son ami Steven, rejette son histoire en la qualifiant de fantasme d'adolescente. Craignant pour sa vie, elle convainc Steven de l'emmener dans une armurerie pour y acheter des balles en argent, où le chien surnaturel de leur voisin l'attaque. Lorsqu'elle élimine la bête, ses actions attirent l'attention de Redd Tucker, un animateur d'émission de chasse à la télévision, qui la croit également. Lorsque Steven est attaqué par le loup-garou et que le frère de Loren disparaît, elle et Redd font équipe pour tuer le lycanthrope avant qu'il ne les achève tous les deux.

programme.title: The Witch In The Window
programme.desc: Lorsque Simon, père divorcé, amène son fils de douze ans, Finn, dans une région rurale du Vermont pour aider à remettre en état une ancienne ferme, ils rencontrent l'esprit malin de Lydia, l'ancienne propriétaire, décédée bien que n'ayant jamais quitté les lieux.

programme.title: La Nettoyeuse

programme.title: L'Œil du Labyrinthe
programme.desc: Jeune et jolie, Julie suit une thérapie auprès du docteur Luca Berti, un homme séduisant qui est non seulement son psychiatre mais aussi son amant. Un matin, elle se réveille brusquement après avoir rêvé de sa mort.

programme.title: La Dame Rouge Tua Sept Fois
programme.desc: Au cœur d'une famille aristocratique, une ancienne légende rôde : celle de la Dame Rouge, un spectre vengeur censé revenir tous les cent ans pour tuer sept fois. Lorsque des meurtres mystérieux commencent à frapper les membres de la famille, la malédiction semble devenir réalité… Mais où s'arrête la légende, et où commence la manipulation ?

programme.title: Night Shot

Comme toujours elle part seule et de nuit avec son cameraman, afin de faire vivre en direct ses aventures à ses followers, avec une particularité : ne jamais couper la caméra...

programme.title: Influencer

Le garde forestier Jack Wells, la paléontologue Kelly Scott, le shérif Hank Keough et le professeur Hector Cry vont devoir affronter un reptile de plus de dix mètres de long, véritable machine à broyer issue de l'espèce des crocodylus.

programme.title: Alan Cumming: “My Dad Told Me I Was Worthless”
programme.desc: Alan Cumming's dad told him he was worthless, and his mum told him he was precious. Figuring out how he feels about himself has been a life's work. In this chat with Fearne, Alan's open about the ways he's allowed people to treat him badly, and how he's learnt to get comfortable with confrontation and setting boundaries. He also explains why the rage in the script of his new TV show triggered painful childhood memories.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Paul Whitehouse & Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE
programme.desc: Comedian Paul Whitehouse and his wife Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE, who has a PhD in neuroscience, discuss emotional regulation and neurodiversity. Mine shares her late ADHD diagnosis at 43 and childhood trauma, while Paul explores how physical health scares have changed his lifestyle. They discuss how the education system needs to change for neurodiverse children, the usefulness of labels, how to calm others with your own behaviour, and why this married couple choose not to live together.

programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Joe Lycett On Fatherhood, Burnout, & Finding Yourself Again
programme.desc: Comedian Joe Lycett discusses identity, fatherhood and burnout with Fearne Cotton. Joe reflects on how much of his stage persona has become who he actually is, why paternity leave triggered existential crises, and how he's come out the other side caring less about what anyone thinks. They also explore losing inhibitions in the age of camera phones, why playing around and making mistakes matters as an adult, and how Ant and Dec have accidentally changed Joe's behaviour at hotels.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Nicole LePera On How To Re-parent Yourself
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Nicole LePera discusses how childhood praise and well-intentioned parenting can leave us with patterns that run our adult lives on autopilot. She explains how to reparent your inner child, starting with finding a childhood photograph, and shares ways to tune in with your body throughout the day to release stress.

programme.title: Bad Boy Magnet and The Insta-Ham
programme.desc: This week at the Millionaire's Club, matchmaker Patti Stanger faces off against Tiffany Foxx, a sexy rap artist and star of “Love and Hip Hop.” Tiffany has a type…bad boys, and her 14-year long relationship was with a man who spent 9 of those years in prison! As predicted, Tiffany fails her love lesson and Patti begins to realize that the problem goes deeper, into childhood. An emotional Tiffany finally recognizes she needs to change. But when Patti throws a test into her mingle, will Tiffany revert to type or reach for true love with a good guy? At the same time, Patti and her team take on Christopher Lourdes, who spends his days posting on Instagram. He uses the social media site to flash his wealth and meet women who are only after one thing…his wallet. Patti needs to put the brakes on his social media frenzy and show him that he's only attracting “Instawhores.” A resistant Christopher finally agrees to try things Patti's way but backslides horribly endangering his possibilities to check out with his date. Both Patti's clients this week need to choose their paths wisely. If they don't, Tiffany and Christopher will leave the club alone.

programme.title: Mr. Hit It And Quit It and The Baywatch Babe
programme.desc: If you think Patti Stanger has faced her toughest clients, you ain't seen nothing yet. When Candace brings in her good friend Marcellas Reynolds, a gay celebrity stylist with a bigger than life personality, Patti certainly has her hands full. Marcellas likes to “hit it and quit it” and never gets beyond surface looks with his partners. But when he miserably fails his love lesson, Patti makes him face his behavior resulting in an explosive moment you'd never expect. Realizing there's more going on than meets the eye, Patti tells Marcellas that he needs to go deeper and be vulnerable with others if he wants a chance at true love. At the same time, Donna D'Errico, a Baywatch babe formerly married to Nikki Sixx from Motley Crue, is back on the dating scene for the first time since her difficult divorce. Soon to be an empty nester, Donna needs Patti's guidance to have fun again and stop assuming men will disappoint her. Both Patti's clients have built walls to protect themselves and she and her team have to go into ninja matchmaker mode to break them down. And if Marcellas and Donna don't follow Patti's rules and open themselves to the possibilities out there, they'll go home alone.

programme.title: Crazy Kelly & The Desperate Housewife
programme.desc: 3rd Generation matchmaker Patti Stanger is back and better than ever. She's taken over an exclusive boutique hotel where she takes on the toughest cases she's ever seen. This week, Patti has two Real Housewives check in: Liar Magnet Claudia Jordan from Atlanta and “Crazy” Kelly Bensimon from New York. Patti helps Kelly get over her nasty reality TV reputation and see that her insecurity is all in her head. Claudia goes deep with Patti, and exposes her traumatic experiences with men that lead her to attract all the wrong men. Patti goes to extreme measures to get Claudia to thoroughly vet guys to find her Mr. Right. It's time to call the man who Claudia needs to confront in order to move on and find true love. Patti and her team gather the best of the best for a sexy all-male mingle where the housewives get their pick of the litter. The Housewives choose their dates, but will Claudia vet her date enough (or too much) and will Kelly keep the “crazy” away? At the end of the week, will these Housewives take their lessons to heart and go home crazy in love or will they check out alone?

programme.title: Mr. Self-Absorbed & The Trainwreck
programme.desc: Patti Stanger has never met clients who challenge her as much as the two this week. TV star Courtney Stodden is only 22 years-old but she's been in the media eye since she was 16, when she controversially married a 50-year-old actor. Now single, Courtney is making up for lost time by partying like a rockstar! Is Courtney straight, bi-sexual or gay, she's not sure so Patti preps for her first ever bi-sexual mingle. What we do know is that Courtney hates rules, she hates being told what to do and she hates keeping her clothes on. Patti is tasked with trying to tame this wild child who is mentally a rebellious 16-year-old, but to do so Patti is forced to use extreme measures. Meanwhile, MMA fighter Shondo Blades checks in with a huge chip on his shoulder and a strong need to be the center of attention. His excuse for having three kids with two women and never married is that women can't keep up with him. But during the love lesson, Patti checks him by pointing out he's a self-absorbed one man show that leaves no room for a co-star. And to add insult to injury, a commitment phoebe. Pissed at the truth, Shondo threatens to leave the Millionaire's Club and tensions explode. Can Patti find a way to break through to her combative clients or will their extreme behaviors sabotage their search for love?

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E3
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E4
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E5
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: As the tide rises in New Zealand's Northland Harbours, Stingrays and Eagle rays swim in to feast on shellfish. But they are not the top of the food chain. Only in New Zealand, and only in these harbours do Orca hunt rays. Trapped in the shallows, the rays breach the surface and swim for their lives, as the Orca pursue – with a highly evolved practice for avoiding the rays' stinging tail. As the tide ebbs, the once underwater world of Northland's mangroves surfaces and seethes. Twisted roots that moments ago sheltered fish are now exposed - a seafood platter for patient Herons, Spoonbills, and Shags.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Just north of New Zealand's biggest city, tens of thousands of fish school meters from the beach in one of the world's first marine reserves. Inside the Goat Island Reserve giant snapper can live for eighty years and crayfish grow to weigh 8 kilos. Both feed on the thousands of sea urchins that graze the kelp forest, maintaining a delicately balanced ecosystem. Like many of the reserve's inhabitants, they entrust their larvae to the ocean currents - so how do they find their way back to the reef when they take on their adult form and settle down?

programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Wild Sardinia
programme.desc: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands. But Sardinia also has other facets: green valleys, rugged mountains, murmuring brooks, mysterious ruins and a unique fauna. Just off of Sardinia's coast is an untouched underwater paradise - uniquely beautiful, but also dangerous. Pilot whales, dolphins and mobula rays populate the waters at Capo Testa in the north of the island. In the west, the lagoons of Cabras represent a wild landscape of lakes in which thousands of flamingos live and hunt the red brine shrimps. In addition to the flamingos, grey and purple herons and little egrets breed here. Thousands of bats have found refuge in the craggy mountain world of the Supramonte and Gennargentu, with their countless grottoes and caves. In the sea we can observe the mass mating of sea slugs, and thanks to our camera robots and submersible boats we were able to observe beard worms with luminous red gills, as well as bright yellow tree corals in the area surrounding the hypothermal lava holes.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns into a sea of almond blossoms. There are around seven million almond trees on the island, once planted to replace dead vines. But now also the almond trees are threatened. The fire bacterium continues to spread, especially on the large plantations. The farmer Biel Torrens wants to save Mallorca's almond trees and fruit with a small organic plantation and gentle harvesting methods. He shakes the almonds from the tree by hand instead of using a mechanical vibrator.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: The contours of the Mediterranean have changed during the course of its history. Near Gibraltar, Africa was once connected to the European continent. When the land bridge at Gibraltar collapsed, the Mediterranean basin filled up again. The Suez Canal is today connected to the Red Sea. This route enables animals to reach the Mediterranean, where they cause problems.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Rugged rocks, blue sea and idyllic, sandy beaches - this is the Mediterranean as we know it. But this impression is deceptive: the Mediterranean is under constant change. The continents are moving towards one another. Animals, that have to survive under such extreme conditions, must find a way to escape the dangers. Between deserts and volcanoes, the challenges for the animals are enormous.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Idlewild - Avalon - Belle of Louisville - these three names stand for the last still roadworthy, historic sternwheeler in the USA. In 1914, the ship was built as "Idlewild" for the West Memphis Packet Company as a passenger ferry. With a draft of only 1.50 m and a robust steel hull, the boat is suitable for almost all navigable rivers of the Mississippi River system. Today, the "Belle" is the most traveled steamboat in American history. In the course of her eventful life, she has called at 130 places in 19 states.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: A tale that will take you back in the past, EK Tha Raja Thi Rani is a dramatic take on the life of royalty. The story revolves around the head of the royal family Ameerkot. The family is headed by a woman, who portrays royalty in all her words and actions. Rajmata wishes the pride and the royalty of her family to always soar up in the sky. In this episode, she is seen eagerly waiting for her son, Rana Indravadhan to arrive home. He is a soldier who had taken part in the World War 2. The scene shifts to Rana Indravadhan, who visits his home. He has visions of the war and how he lost his fellow men in the war. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Tha Rani to learn more about his tale.Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal, but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI FROM SACHKHAND SRI HARMANDIR SAHIB, AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.9
programme.desc: Dam Pyung Joon accepts Kang Chi and Tae Seo into the Mu Hyung Do Gwan (martial arts school), and Kang Chi strives to become a formal disciple. Jo Gwan Woong, suspicious of the Hundred Year Inn's asset list, searches for a secret vault. Meanwhile, Yi Sun Shin and Dam Pyung Joon plot to retrieve 5,000 nyang of silver without Gwan Woong's knowledge.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.10
programme.desc: Kang Chi and Yeo Wool are trapped in the room where the silver chest is hidden. Seo-bwagwan grows suspicious of the wall hidden behind a scroll. Meanwhile, seeing Yeo Wool's scar, Kang Chi remembers his childhood encounter with her.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.11
programme.desc: Kang Chi is asked by Tae Seo to rescue Chung Jo. He worries about how Chung Jo will react to his half-beast nature. Yeo Wool comforts him, saying he is still Choi Kang Chi, regardless of his appearance. Meanwhile, the Hundred Year Inn staff hear that Chung Jo is to spend the night with Jo Gwan Woong.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.12
programme.desc: To save Chung Jo, Tae Seo reveals Kang Chi's location to Jo Gwan Woong. Tae Seo attempts to behead Kang Chi himself and cuts off his prayer bead bracelet. Kang Chi transforms into his beast form in front of Tae Seo and Chung Jo. Seo-bwagwan, sensing Kang Chi is Wol Ryung and Seo Hwa's son, reports this to Jo Gwan Woong.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.13
programme.desc: Yeo Wool is put in charge of Kang Chi's discipline at the school. Despite their bickering, they grow closer and go to see the lantern festival. Meanwhile, unusual corpses are found in the forest, and the school's disciples begin to suspect Kang Chi.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.14
programme.desc: Kang Chi and Yeo Wool enjoy the lantern festival. However, when a disciple is found dead with his liver eaten, Kang Chi falls under deeper suspicion. Tae Seo returns to the inn and tells Jo Gwan Woong about Yi Sun Shin's plan to build a new 'ironclad' ship.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Tiraditos! No, it's not a joyous exclamation (even though it sounds a little like one...) it's a Peruvian dish that lands somewhere between traditional Peruvian ceviche and Japanese sashimi. Chef Craig Wong's version is made with swordfish and includes sweet potatoes pureed with spicy Aji Amarillo chilies. For his Lebanese tribute, check out Lamb Neck cured and slow-poached in olive oil for a melt-in- your-mouth result, paired with an intense, flavourful Black Baba Ghanoush made with charred eggplant and caramelized onions. For a common ingredient, it is two takes on potato: Lomo Saltado with grilled flank steak, and a cheese, herb, olive oil and lemon drenched Hasselback Batata Harra. Squab is on the final plate blending Lebanese flavours like sumac, pomegranate, and pistachio with Peruvian ones like sweet corn, squash, and lime. What a CombiNation!

programme.title: Passioni e Desideri

programme.title: Lo scafandro e la farfalla
programme.desc: L'8 dicembre 1995, Jean-Dominique Bauby - giornalista e padre di due figli - cade improvvisamente in coma. Quando si sveglia è immobilizzato, colpito da quella che la medicina definisce "sindrome locked-in": riesce a muovere solo la palpebra sinistra, che diventa il suo legame con il mondo...

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: Jack Il Ciclone
programme.desc: Jack è tornato e stavolta è alle prese congli half-pipe delle cime innevate del Colorado. Jack fa squadra con due fratelli e diventa presto un campione dello snowboard! Le sue abilità lo portano dove nessuno scimpanzé era stato prima.

programme.title: Il regno di Wuba 2
programme.desc: Il piccolo Wuba, destinato al trono, si rimette in viaggio in una Cina favolosa, al confine tra il mondo degli uomini e quello dei mostri, separandosi dai propri genitori ma trovando nuovi alleati lungo la via.

programme.title: Argonuts – Missione Olimpo
programme.desc: Preparati a partire per un viaggio mitico in compagnia dell'avventurosa e super smart topolina Pixi e del suo compagno, il gatto Sam. I due amici affronteranno le creature più stravaganti e pericolose della mitologia greca per aiutare il valoroso eroe Giasone e i suoi argonauti a salvare la città...

programme.title: Il mio piccolo dinosauro
programme.desc: Il giovane Jake cresce in un borgo dove non accade mai nulla di eccitante. Un giorno il ragazzino si ritrova in camera un piccolo dinosauro blu che diventa il suo nuovo meraviglioso amico.

programme.title: Quella peste di Pierina
programme.desc: Pierina ha soltanto tredici anni ed adora fare brutti scherzi a chiunque, soprattutto a scuola e a casa. Gianmaria è un ragazzino innamorato di lei, ma la giovane non ha intenzione di ricambiarlo.

programme.title: Le foto proibite di una signora per bene
programme.desc: Minou, moglie di Pierre, è perseguitata da un maniaco. Costretta a sottostare alle sue voglie, la donna viene ricattata dall'uomo, che minaccia di mostrare al marito le prove fotografiche del suo tradimento.

programme.title: Cam Girl
programme.desc: Naufragato il sogno di un impiego nell'agenzia pubblicitaria in cui ha fatto uno stage, la copywriter Alice decide di fronteggiare la precarietà della propria situazione allestendo un'agenzia di cam-girl insieme alle amiche Rossella, Martina e Gilda. Dopo aver superato le problematiche relative all'avvio dell'attività, il progetto di Cam Together sembra andare a gonfie vele.

programme.title: Guardami
programme.desc: Nina sceglie di fare l'attrice porno senza problemi e senza illusioni, un po' perché le piace il sesso un po' per curiosità. La vita di Nina, legata sentimentalmente con Cristiana, una redattrice di una rivista hard, cambia radicalmente, un brutto giorno, quando scopre di avere il cancro. Così il corpo che le è sempre servito per lavorare, farsi ammirare e far godere, si rivolta contro di lei.

programme.title: Detenuto in attesa di giudizio
programme.desc: Giuseppe è un geometra emigrato in Svezia, dove ha fatto fortuna con la sua piccola impresa edile. Torna in Italia per far conoscere il suo Paese alla moglie Ingrid, ma alla frontiera viene inspiegabilmente fermato e quindi arrestato. In carcere, scopre di essere accusato di un delitto gravissimo. Una delle rare interpretazioni drammatiche del magistrale Alberto Sordi.

programme.title: Genitori in blue jeans
programme.desc: Una serie di personaggi della Roma bene degli anni '50 frequenta la rinomata sartoria di Peppino, un uomo che ha respinto tutte le proposte di matrimonio che gli sono state fatte negli anni. Durante un viaggio a Parigi, Peppino conosce una donna e finalmente se ne innamora, ma proprio dopo aver deciso di sposarla viene a scoprire qualcosa di inaspettato.

programme.title: La bambolona
programme.desc: Un avvocato, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, perde la testa per una ragazza che apparentemente sembra ingenua e sprovveduta. In realtà, la giovane donna sfrutta astutamente la sua bellezza per abbindolare il suo maturo spasimante.

programme.title: I Cuori Infranti
programme.desc: Una divertente commedia che rompe i classici schemi dell'amore. Il film è diviso in due episodi: nel primo, protagonista è una ragazza che riesce a impedire le nozze dell'amato con una rivale. Nel secondo, l'equilibrio di una perfetta famiglia si regge sul ruolo casalingo di lui, e su quello di lei, che procura i soldi tramite attività poco convenzionali.

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani
programme.desc: Trio di novelle, tre ritratti di donna che si avvalgono dell`eclettico brio interpretativo di Sophia Loren. Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: Rappresaglia
programme.desc: Roma 23 Marzo 1944. Le truppe tedesche tengono la città sotto il loro controllo. In seguito ad un attentato contro una compagnia delle SS compiuto in via Rasella, il generale Maelzer informa i suoi capi a Berlino che, decisi ad abrogare qualunque soglia di tolleranza, ordinano una veloce rappresaglia, pretendendo l`esecuzione di dieci italiani per ogni tedesco ucciso. Sarà il tenente colonnello Herbert Kapller a gestire l`intervento e a compilare la lista dei sacrificati, nonostante il suo aperto dissenso.

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: Micheal Jackson
programme.sub-title: Chi ha ucciso il re del pop
programme.desc: 25 giugno 2009. La morte di Michael Jackson sconvolge il mondo. Chi ha ucciso il re del pop? Sembra che ognuno abbia una sua teoria, dall'omicidio premeditato al tragico suicidio. Contiene interviste e testimonianze dirette di Jermaine e Tito Jackson, Elizabeth Taylor, Diana Ross e altri. Riprese di provini, video della vita privata, la telefonata al 911 e la cerimonia funebre. Attraverso gli alti e bassi della vita di Michael, questa 'inside story' esamina i fattori e gli eventi che hanno contribuito alla sua morte

programme.title: Cacciatore di teste
programme.desc: Bruno Davert è un manager del settore della carta di mezza età che ha perso il lavoro a causa di una ristrutturazione e delocalizzazione della sua azienda. Convinto di trovare immediatamente un altro lavoro all'altezza del suo curriculum, dopo oltre due anni di ricerche si ritrova ancora disoccupato. Decide così di mettere in atto un piano destinato a restituirgli il lavoro presso la principale azienda del settore, la Arcadia. Il piano consiste nell'eliminazione fisica di tutti i suoi principali concorrenti, altri manager che come lui hanno perso il posto e vivono di espedienti partecipando ad umilianti colloqui di lavoro.

programme.title: La Regina degli scacchi
programme.desc: Maria Adele, 17 anni, vive per gli scacchi, ma scopre di essere stata adottata e, con l'aiuto di un giornalista, rintraccia la madre biologica. Mentre riaffiora un ricordo d'infanzia che la libera dai tormenti, emerge un'indagine che svela crimini del suo maestro di scacchi, culminati in un tragico epilogo.

programme.desc: La sensuale Havana è raccontata da sette registi con stili molto diversi. Un film collettivo in cui ogni storia, interconnessa con le altre, si sviluppa nell'arco di una giornata, offrendo uno spaccato della città e delle sue emozioni più intime e contrastanti.

programme.title: I'm Your Man
programme.desc: Alma è una scienziata del famoso Museo Pergamon di Berlino. Al fine di ottenere dei fondi per il suo lavoro di ricercatrice, si fa convincere a partecipare a uno studio alquanto particolare. Per tre settimane dovrà vivere con un robot umanoide creato su misura in base al suo carattere e ai suoi bisogni, e la cui intelligenza artificiale è progettata per essere il suo compagno di vita perfetto.

programme.desc: Esausta dal suo lavoro di marketing, Sophie affitta un Airbnb da un padre vedovo e sua figlia per rilassarsi. Tuttavia, la figlia è decisa a far innamorare ancora una volta suo padre, con gli occhi puntati su Sophie.

programme.title: Una pasticceria d'amare
programme.desc: Jessie Dale è una fornaia di terza generazione che ama la sua pasticceria più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando gli sviluppatori minacciano di acquistare il suo edificio e costringerla ad andarsene, deve fare tutto il possibile per salvare la sua panetteria, il tutto mentre si destreggia in una storia d'amore in fiore con il fratello del suo cliente.

programme.title: Una festa da sogno
programme.desc: Kelly è una giovane, creativa e ambiziosa pianificatrice di eventi a New York e sta rapidamente guadagnando reputazione come una delle migliori nel settore. Ma quando Joe, un editore di siti web testardo, difficile ma influente, la assume per organizzare il compleanno della nipote di 10 anni, Kelly si rende rapidamente conto di aver appena incontrato il suo match.

programme.title: Sulle orme dell'amore
programme.desc: Quando il suo museo d'arte affronta problemi finanziari, una curatrice convenzionale collabora con un artista d'avanguardia per sviluppare una mostra non convenzionale. Impara a pensare fuori dagli schemi per salvare il museo e trovare l'amore.

programme.title: La mia versione dell'amore
programme.desc: Rebecca, un'esperta di immagine incredibilmente di successo che si specializza nel tirare fuori la migliore versione di se stessi, si trova di fronte alla sua sfida più formidabile in Clive, un ex calciatore affascinante ma molto radicato nelle sue abitudini.

programme.title: Dance off: sfida a ritmo di danza
programme.desc: Due squadre di danza rivali della stessa città si affrontano per il Campionato Nazionale.

programme.title: LOL
programme.desc: Lola è inseparabile dagli amici del cuore, Emily e Kyle, e ha una cotta per Chad. Al rientro a scuola dopo le vacanze, si accorge amaramente di non contare molto per lui e deve ammettere a sua volta di essere da sempre innamorata di Kyle.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Quando Joel (Paul Rudd) e Molly (Amy Poehler) si incontrano, è odio a prima vista: la grande azienda produttrice di dolciumi di lui minaccia di far chiudere la piccola impresa indipendente di lei.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack è uno scrittore in difficoltà i cui ideali di speranza sono stati soppressi dal rifiuto e dalla solitudine, ma la sua vita è destinata a cambiare in seguito all'incontro con Maria, una ragazza allegra e molto superstiziosa.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artista trova improvvisamente la sua vita sconvolta quando la sua mostra d'arte viene cancellata e la sua fidanzata modella lo abbandona. Costretto a trasferirsi in un palazzo fatiscente, incontra pazzoidi, una donna di mezza, una prostituta matta e un dongiovanni spagnolo.

programme.title: Il segreto delle Api
programme.desc: La dottoressa Jean Markham torna nella città che aveva lasciato da adolescente per occuparsi dello studio del padre.

programme.title: Ask me anything
programme.desc: Bella e giovane, Katie ha deciso di prendersi un anno di pausa prima di iniziare il college. Vorrebbe scoprire se stessa e andare oltre il suo noioso lavoro nella libreria locale e le giornate a fumare con il suo fidanzato. Ha intenzione di sedurre Dan, un professore trentaduenne del college.

programme.title: L'amore oltre la guerra
programme.desc: Un soldato tedesco cerca di capire se la resistenza olandese è riuscita a far infiltrare una spia nella casa del Kaiser Wilhem in Olanda all'inizio della Seconda guerra mondiale. Durante l'indagine finirà però con l'innamorarsi di una olandese ebrea.

programme.title: The burial – il caso o'keefe
programme.desc: Quando un accordo va a monte, il proprietario di un'impresa funebre Jeremiah O'Keefe (il premio Oscar Tommy Lee Jones) si rivolge all'avvocato Willie E. Gary (il premio Oscar Jamie Foxx) per salvare la sua azienda.

programme.title: Il giorno del venerdì santo
programme.desc: Harold Sand è un capo della malavita londinese che vede i suoi traffici ostacolati da una serie di attentati contro gli uomini della sua banda.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Audrey si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere di una rubrica di consigli sull'amore speciale ma anonima. Mentre è lì, incontra il redattore capo, Morgan Cooper. Presto scoppieranno scintille tra di loro. Audrey sarà la protagonista della sua storia d'amore?

programme.title: Latelier dei miei sogni
programme.desc: La stilista Skye si sposta con un "camion della moda"ma non può guidare il camion e gestire l'attività da sola. L'aiuto arriva sotto forma de Kevin. Mentre lavorano insieme, Skye e Kevin scoprono di avere più cose in comune di quanto pensassero...

programme.title: Sam
programme.desc: Sam non perde mai l'occasione per incontrare nuove ragazze. Dopo aver abbandonato un addio al celibato, si imbatte in un negoziante che gli offre una bibita misteriosa e il dongiovanni la beve. Sam si risveglia nel corpo di una bellissima donna.

programme.title: Un bianco Natale
programme.desc: Kelly Mitchum torna a casa per trascorrere il Natale con la sua famiglia. Mentre sogna di trovare il suo uomo perfetto, incontra il l'imprenditore Forrest Newell. Ora, con la casa della sua famiglia a rischio di demolizione, Forrest può aiutarla?

programme.title: La damigella perfetta
programme.desc: Becca è sempre la damigella d'onore, ma al matrimonio di suo cugino lega con Kyle. Che sia l'ultima volta?

programme.title: Lezioni di sogni Lezioni di sogni
programme.desc: Il professor Konrad Koch insegna ai suoi studenti a giocare a calcio mentre parlano inglese.

programme.desc: Frank è ossessionato dall'idea di ottenere una seconda stella per il suo ristorante.

programme.desc: Beethoven ha sempre avuto tre passioni: la musica, la libertà e la verità.

programme.title: Louis van Beethoven
